input_plan.query: Which two shared braking-defect themes have the highest matched complaint counts across Chevrolet complaint narratives, recall defect summaries, and investigation reports when all three describe the same defect or risk? For each ranked theme, how many distinct recall campaigns are involved, which investigation report IDs are related, and what short ODI risk summary captures the issue?

reference_semantic_plan.program: SCAN_TABLE(NHTSA, complaints, [complaint_id, make, component_id, summary_text]) -> FILTER(make='CHEVROLET' AND component_id='BRAKES') -> SEM_JOIN('Within Chevrolet BRAKES records, match a complaint to a recall only when the complaint narrative and recall defect summary describe the same braking defect or risk.', input_bindings_left={complaint_summary: summary_text, component_id: component_id}, input_bindings_right={recall_defect: r.risk.defect_summary, component_id: r.component_id}, right=( SCAN_DOCS(NHTSA, recalls AS r, [campaign.number, vehicle.make AS make, component.component_id AS component_id, risk.defect_summary, risk.consequence_summary]) -> FILTER(vehicle.make='CHEVROLET' AND component.component_id='BRAKES') )) -> SEM_EXTRACT('Extract the shared braking defect theme in <=8 words.', out_schema={defect_theme: string}, input_bindings={complaint_text: summary_text, recall_text: r.risk.defect_summary}) -> SEM_FILTER('the matched evidence describes a braking safety risk with potential crash, loss-of-control, or extended-stopping consequence', input_bindings={complaint_text: summary_text, recall_consequence: r.risk.consequence_summary}) -> SEM_JOIN('Match the braking defect theme to an investigation report only when the report discusses the same Chevrolet/GM braking issue or ODI risk finding.', input_bindings_left={theme: defect_theme, complaint_text: summary_text, recall_text: r.risk.defect_summary}, input_bindings_right={report_body: body}, right=( SCAN_DOCS(NHTSA, investigation_reports, selector='*.txt', columns=[file_id, body]) -> FILTER(body CONTAINS 'Chevrolet' OR body CONTAINS 'GM' OR body CONTAINS 'brake') )) -> GROUP_BY([defect_theme], aggs={matched_complaint_count: count_distinct(complaint_id), distinct_campaign_count: count_distinct(r.campaign.number), related_report_ids: collect_distinct_sorted(file_id, 'asc'), report_bodies: collect_distinct(body)}) -> SEM_AGGREGATE('Summarize the ODI braking risk finding for this defect theme in one short phrase.', out_schema={odi_risk_summary: string}, group_by=[defect_theme], input_bindings={reports: report_bodies}) -> ORDER_BY([matched_complaint_count DESC, defect_theme ASC]) -> LIMIT(5) -> PROJECT([rank: row_number(), defect_theme, matched_complaint_count, distinct_campaign_count, related_report_ids, odi_risk_summary])
